contracts.actual_behavior: Mod constructor registers entity/item/effect/block/material/config and actual event/network handlers. Server Post tick decrements each queued integer, runs only entries whose new value equals0, then removes those executed entries. Zero or negative initial delay becomes negative and never executes; positive N runs after N Post callbacks, queue concurrency/iteration stays native. Runnable exceptions are not caught here. Packet send helpers delegate exact distribution, no extra payload. Prefix uses namespace legendarymonsters (no underscore), lowercase Locale.ROOT; registries otherwise legendary_monsters. Empty common/creative setup methods introduce no effects. Presentation client registry is separately excluded.
